description: Search verified events in one city. Results are sorted by start date and include the event page, the calendar (.ics) link, the verification date and, where the event page carries one, a booking link. Dates marked expected are expected dates, not yet confirmed by the organiser. If from_date and to_date are omitted, the window defaults to today through today plus 30 days in the city's local time. An empty result includes the nearest later date that does have events. This server is read-only: it takes no bookings, and prices and availability are confirmed on the merchant's site.

category.description: Optional category; one of the city's own category values, listed by list_cities.

city.description: City slug or name from list_cities, for example "hong-kong".

from_date.description: Start of the window, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in the city's timezone.

keyword.description: Optional keyword matched against the event name, local name, venue and short description.

limit.description: Maximum events to return. Default 10, maximum 25.

to_date.description: End of the window, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today plus 30 days in the city's timezone.

name: search_events
title: Search events in a city by date range, category and keyword
